faqItems.question: What is LoraField and how does it work?
faqItems.answer: LoraField is a smart web-based irrigation system that combines IoT sensors, BMKG weather data, and valve automation. Sensors in your farm read soil conditions in real-time, then the system determines whether irrigation needs to be opened, closed, or delayed based on soil moisture and weather predictions. All data can be monitored directly from the dashboard.

faqItems.question: Do I need technical expertise to install the devices?
faqItems.answer: No. Sensor and gateway devices are designed to be easily installed in the field. Once connected, your farm will automatically appear on the dashboard and be ready to configure. We also provide step-by-step installation guides.

faqItems.question: How many farms can I manage with one account?
faqItems.answer: One account can manage many farms at once. Each farm has its own location map, crop type, sensor nodes, and independent irrigation rules. So if you have land in multiple locations, everything is still monitored from a single dashboard.

faqItems.question: What if my farm location has poor internet signal?
faqItems.answer: LoraField gateway transmits data over LoRa network which is power-efficient and has long range. As long as there is minimal cellular signal around the gateway, data still reaches the dashboard. If the gateway goes offline temporarily, the system will wait for data to return to normal before making irrigation decisions.

faqItems.question: Can this system be used for crops other than rice?
faqItems.answer: Yes. LoraField supports more than 30 crop types, from chili, tomatoes, and melons to ornamental plants. Each crop has its own soil moisture threshold (VWC) stored in the system, so irrigation is adjusted to each crop needs.

faqItems.question: Is my farm data secure?
faqItems.answer: Very secure. Each user can only access their own farms. Sensor data, irrigation history, and profile information are protected with encryption. We also use JWT authentication and OTP verification to maintain account security.
